<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—a monoisotopic peak at m/z 183.045 (100 % intensity), a +1 Da peak at ~10 % (consistent with natural 13C abundance for ~10 carbons), and a +2 Da peak at ~33 % (matching the characteristic ~3:1 M:M+2 ratio of chlorine), the elements that can be definitively identified are carbon and chlorine.</thought>
<final_answer>['C', 'Cl']</final_answer>
